comparison.objective: Fit and center an inside-bolt-circle gasket using bolts as placement stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Insert the far bolts, slide and center a gasket against them, then insert the near bolts.
comparison.success_condition: Gasket flat and within 4 mm of pipe axis; all four bolts upright, seated, still, and released. No tightening, force, or dynamic threshold.
comparison.reason: Tests order-dependent insertion and geometric centering, not fine locking-tool manipulation or iterative damping performance.
